summary.text: Cisco Aguilar is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of State, an attorney and founder of a sports technology company elected in 2022. His campaign highlights business-licensing modernization, election cybersecurity and protections for election workers.

paragraphs.text: Earned a B.S. in finance and accounting, an M.B.A. and a J.D., all from the University of Arizona.

Worked as special counsel to the chancellor of the Nevada System of Higher Education and as general counsel for the Andre Agassi Foundation for Education; appointed to the Nevada Athletic Commission by Govs. Gibbons and Sandoval.

sources.title: Record and Plan — Cisco Aguilar for Secretary of State
